metadata.question: Did clouds cover a larger area within a 10 km radius of Halema‘uma‘u Crater, the summit caldera of Hawaii’s Kīlauea volcano, than the volcanic plume on July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Halema'uma'u Crater, Kīlauea volcano, Hawaii (~19.4068°N, -155.2834°W) - Date: July 20, 2025, 10:44 am local time (Hawaii is UTC-10, so 20:44 UTC on July 20, 2025) - Need high temporal resolution imagery - GOES-18 for near-real-time observations - 10 km radius around the crater 2. Masking strategy: - NO masking - the question asks to COMPARE cloud area vs volcanic plume area - Need to identify and separate clouds from volcanic plumes - Use appropriate bands: GOES-18 has CMI (Cloud and Moisture Imagery) bands - Clouds: typically identified using visible/IR bands and cloud mask products - Volcanic plume: SO2, ash, thermal anomalies 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid comparison: clouds area > plume area → A, else → B - C1: No GOES imagery at that specific time - C2: After processing, no valid pixels in the region - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const crater = ee.Geometry.Point([-155.2834, 19.4068]); const roi = crater.buffer(10000); // 10 km radius // July 20, 2025, 10:44 am HST = 20:44 UTC const targetTime = ee.Date('2025-07-20T20:44:00'); const startTime = targetTime.advance(-30, 'minute'); const endTime = targetTime.advance(30, 'minute'); console.log('Target time: 2025-07-20 10:44 HST (20:44 UTC)'); console.log('Region: 10km radius around Halemaʻumaʻu Crater'); // 2. Data Acquisition - GOES-18 for Hawaii let goes = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/GOES/18/MCMIPF') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(startTime, endTime); const goesCount = goes.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GOES-18 images found: ${goesCount}`); if (goesCount === 0) { console.log('No GOES-18 imagery available for this time.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get closest image to target time const img = ee.Image(goes.sort('system:time_start').first()); const imgTime = new Date(img.get('system:time_start').getInfo()); console.log(`Using image from: ${imgTime.toISOString()}`); // 3. Extract cloud mask and calculate cloud area // GOES has DQF (Data Quality Flag) where clouds are identified const cloudMask = img.select('DQF').eq(0); // DQF=0 indicates good quality (clear) const clouds = cloudMask.not(); // Invert to get clouds // Count cloud pixels const cloudStats = clouds.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 2000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const cloudPixels = cloudStats.get('DQF').getInfo(); if (cloudPixels === null) { console.log('Cloud calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 4. Estimate volcanic plume area using thermal and SO2 indicators // Use brightness temperature difference for plume detection const bt11 = img.select('CMI_C13'); // 10.3 μm IR band const bt14 = img.select('CMI_C15'); // 12.3 μm IR band // Volcanic plume shows brightness temperature anomaly const btDiff = bt14.subtract(bt11); // Plume detection: negative BT difference and high thermal signature const plume = btDiff.lt(-2).and(bt11.gt(270)); // Typical volcanic plume signature const plumeStats = plume.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 2000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const plumePixels = plumeStats.get('CMI_C15').getInfo(); if (plumePixels === null) { console.log('Plume calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 5. Check for valid pixels const totalStats = img.select('CMI_C13').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 2000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const totalPixels = totalStats.get('CMI_C13').getInfo(); if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in region.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Compare areas console.log(`Total pixels: ${totalPixels}`); console.log(`Cloud pixels: ${cloudPixels}`); console.log(`Plume pixels: ${plumePixels}`); console.log(`Cloud coverage: ${((cloudPixels/totalPixels)*100).toFixed(1)}%`); console.log(`Plume coverage: ${((plumePixels/totalPixels)*100).toFixed(1)}%`); if (cloudPixels > plumePixels) { console.log('Clouds cover larger area than volcanic plume.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Volcanic plume covers equal or larger area than clouds.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
